description_en: Updates the configuration of a specified AI agent instance
description_zh: 修改指定AI智能体实例的配置信息
name: UpdateAIAgentInstance

parameters.help_en:
The agent instance ID.

The InstanceId is the unique ID returned after the agent instance is successfully started. For more information about the API operations used to start an agent, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846201.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846209.html
parameters.help_zh:
智能体实例ID。

InstanceId为智能体实例启动成功后，返回的唯一的Id。启动智能体接口，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846201.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846209.html
parameters.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the call ambient sound. You can obtain the ID from the advanced settings of the agent configuration in the console
fields.help_zh: 通话环境音ID，可以在控制台上智能体配置的高级配置中获取
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The volume of the call background sound. Valid values: 0 to 100. A value of 0 indicates that the background sound is disabled
fields.help_zh: 通话背景音的音量，可选值：[0, 100]，0表示关闭
fields.name: volume

fields.help_en: The call ambient sound configuration
fields.help_zh: 通话环境音配置
fields.name: ambient_sound_config

fields.example: [{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"阿里云、通义千问、Qwen-Audio"}]},{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"好的，我会结合这些术语继续交流。"}]}]
fields.help_en: The ASR context enhancement
fields.help_zh: ASR 上下文增强
fields.name: asr_context

fields.help_en: The ASR hotword list. The list supports a maximum of 128 hotwords
fields.help_zh: Asr 热词列表。热词列表最大支持 128 个词
fields.name: asr_hot_words

fields.help_en:
The ASR language ID. Valid values:
zh_mandarin: Chinese.
en: English.
zh_en: Mixed Chinese and English.
es: Spanish.
jp: Japanese
fields.help_zh:
asr 语种 Id。 可选：

zh_mandarin 中文

en 英文

zh_en 中英混

es 西班牙语

jp 日语
fields.name: asr_language_id

fields.help_en: The threshold for speech segmentation detection. If the silence duration exceeds this threshold, the speech is considered segmented. Valid values: 200 to 1200. Unit: milliseconds. Default value: 400
fields.help_zh: 语音断句检测阈值，静音时长超过该阈值会被认为断句，参数范围 200ms～1200ms，默认值 400ms
fields.name: asr_max_silence

fields.example: {"通义千问":4,"Qwen-Audio":5,"阿里云语音实验室":50}
fields.help_en: The instance-level real-time hotwords and their weights for ASR
fields.help_zh: ASR 实例级即时热词及权重
fields.name: asr_vocabulary

fields.help_en: The pass-through parameters for custom ASR integration
fields.help_zh: asr自研接入透传参数
fields.name: custom_params

fields.help_en: The minimum duration threshold for voice activity detection (VAD), which is used to control the sensitivity of interruptions. A value of 0 indicates that this feature is disabled. Valid values: 200 to 2000. Unit: milliseconds. Common values range from 200 to 500, which correspond to 1 to 4 words. Default value: null. If this parameter is left empty, this feature does not take effect
fields.help_zh: 语音活动检测的最短持续时间阈值，用于控制打断的灵敏度。0表示关闭此功能。有效范围：200到2000毫秒。常用[200,500] 对应1-4个字。默认为空，不生效
fields.name: vad_duration

fields.help_en:
The interruption threshold parameter. Valid values: 0 to 11. Default value: 11.
0: Disables the VAD feature.
1 to 10: A larger value indicates that it is more difficult to trigger an interruption.
11: Significantly different from previous values. It causes less damage to the pre-processed conversation audio and provides stronger anti-interference capability
fields.help_zh:
打断阈值参数。取值范围：[0,11], 默认值：11。

0表示关闭 vad 功能。
1-10设置数字越高表示越难打断。
11与之前显著不同，前处理对话音损伤更低，抗干扰更强
fields.name: vad_level

fields.help_en: The speech recognition configuration
fields.help_zh: 语音识别配置
fields.name: asr_config

fields.help_en: The selection probability of the prompt. Valid values: 0 to 1, which correspond to 0% to 100%
fields.help_zh: 提示语的选择概率，范围 0–1，对应0%-100%
fields.name: probability

fields.help_en: The text of the inquiry prompt. Maximum length: 100 characters
fields.help_zh: 问询提示语文本，最长 100 字符
fields.name: text

fields.help_en: The collection of inquiry prompts. A maximum of 10 prompts are supported. Each prompt can be up to 100 characters in length. The sum of probabilities must be 100%
fields.help_zh: 问询提示语集合，最大 10 条，每条长度 ≤ 100 字符，概率总和为100%
fields.name: messages

fields.help_en:
The mode for selecting the soothing prompt from LlmPending.Messages to broadcast while waiting for the agent to reply. Valid values:
ai_select: The AI selects the most appropriate prompt from Messages based on the current conversation. This mode does not check whether the sum of Probability values is 1, but WaitTime cannot be less than 800 milliseconds. This is the default value.
probability: A prompt is randomly selected based on the Probability weight of each prompt. The sum of all Probability values must be exactly 1.0
fields.help_zh:
等智能体回复时，选择哪条安抚语（LlmPending.Messages）来播报。取值：
ai_select（默认）：由 AI 根据当前对话，从 Messages 里挑最合适的一条。这种方式不检查 Probability 加起来是否为 1，但 WaitTime 不能小于 800 毫秒。
probability：按每条的 Probability 权重随机挑一条。所有 Probability 加起来必须等于 1.0
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The threshold for the waiting time for a response from the large language model (LLM). If the waiting time exceeds this threshold, a broadcast prompt is triggered. This parameter is required. Valid values: 500 to 10000. Unit: milliseconds. Set this parameter based on the actual usage of the LLM
fields.help_zh: 等待大模型回复时长阈值。超过此时长，触发播报提示。必填，单位毫秒，范围 500–10000ms。请用户根据大模型的实际使用
fields.name: wait_time

fields.help_en: The broadcast configuration for LLM response delays
fields.help_zh: LLM 响应延迟时的播报配置
fields.name: llm_pending

fields.help_en: The hang-up closing remark. It is broadcast before the call is hung up after a prolonged period of user unresponsiveness. Maximum length: 200 characters
fields.help_zh: 挂断结束语，用户长时间无响应后挂断前播报，最大长度 200
fields.name: hangup_end_word

fields.help_en: The maximum number of inquiries. Valid values: 0 to 10. This parameter is required. If the number of inquiries exceeds this value, no more inquiries are triggered and the call is directly closed
fields.help_zh: 最大问询次数，范围 0–10，必填。超过后不再触发，直接关闭通话
fields.name: max_repeats

fields.help_en: The selection probability of the prompt. Valid values: 0 to 1, which correspond to 0% to 100%
fields.help_zh: 提示语的选择概率，范围 0–1，对应0%-100%
fields.name: probability

fields.help_en: The text of the inquiry prompt. Maximum length: 100 characters
fields.help_zh: 问询提示语文本，最长 100 字符
fields.name: text

fields.help_en: The collection of inquiry prompts. A maximum of 10 prompts are supported. Each prompt can be up to 100 characters in length. The sum of probabilities must be 100%
fields.help_zh: 问询提示语集合，最大 10 条，每条长度 ≤ 100 字符，概率总和为100%
fields.name: messages

fields.help_en: The silence duration threshold. This parameter is required. If the silence duration exceeds this threshold, an inquiry is triggered. Valid values: 5000 to 600000. Unit: milliseconds
fields.help_zh: 静默时长阈值，单位毫秒，必填。超过此时长触发问询。范围 5000–600000ms
fields.name: wait_time

fields.help_en: The broadcast configuration for inquiries during prolonged user silence
fields.help_zh: 用户长时间静默时的问询播报配置
fields.name: user_idle

fields.help_en: The automatic speech configuration module for the agent, which includes prompts for LLM response delays and inquiries during prolonged user silence
fields.help_zh: 智能体自动说话配置模块，包括 LLM 等待提示和用户长时间静默问询
fields.name: auto_speech_config

fields.help_en: The model ID of the digital human
fields.help_zh: 数字人的模型id
fields.name: avatar_id

fields.help_en:
The resolution of the digital human video stream. The value must be in strictly lowercase letters and must be specified together with AvatarId. Valid values:
360p
480p
720p
1080p
fields.help_zh:
用于指定数字人视频流的分辨率,（严格小写匹配），必须与 `AvatarId` 同时传。取值：
360p
480p
720p
1080p
fields.name: resolution

fields.help_en: The ID of the digital human template, which specifies the template used when the digital human is started. The template is provided by the digital human service provider, and the provider also verifies whether the specified value is valid
fields.help_zh: 数字人模板 ID，用来指定数字人启动时用哪个模板。模板由数字人服务方提供，填的值是否有效也由服务方检查
fields.name: template_id

fields.help_en: The digital human configuration. This configuration takes effect only when the workflow includes a digital human node
fields.help_zh: 数字人配置，只有当工作流中包含数字人节点才会生效
fields.name: avatar_config

fields.help_en: The URL of the agent avatar for voice calls. Default value: none
fields.help_zh: 语音通话的智能体头像的头像链接。默认无

fields.help_en: The URL type of the agent avatar. Default value: none
fields.help_zh: 智能体头像链接类型，默认无
fields.name: avatar_url_type

fields.help_zh: 是否启用附和功能。必填，取值 true/false
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The trigger probability of the feature. Valid values: 0.0 to 1.0. This parameter is required
fields.help_zh: 功能触发概率。范围 0.0–1.0。必填
fields.name: probability

fields.help_en:
The trigger stage for backchanneling. Valid values:
pause_detected: A short pause in speech is detected
fields.help_zh:
附和触发的时机。可选值：

pause_detected（检测到说话短暂停顿）
fields.name: trigger_stage

fields.help_en: The trigger probability of the phrase. Valid values: 0.0 to 1.0. This parameter is required
fields.help_zh: 本短语的触发概率，范围 0.0–1.0，必填
fields.name: probability

fields.help_en: The text of the phrase. Maximum length: 20 characters. Multiple languages are supported. This parameter is required
fields.help_zh: 短语文本，长度 ≤ 20 字符，支持多语言。必填

fields.help_zh: 是否启用附和功能。必填，取值 true/false

fields.help_en: The trigger probability of the feature. Valid values: 0.0 to 1.0. This parameter is required
fields.help_zh: 功能触发概率。范围 0.0–1.0。必填

The trigger stage for backchanneling. Valid values:

fields.name: probability

fields.help_en: The text of the phrase. Maximum length: 20 characters. Multiple languages are supported. This parameter is required
fields.help_zh: 短语文本，长度 ≤ 20 字符，支持多语言。必填
fields.name: text

fields.help_en: The collection of backchanneling phrases. A maximum of 10 phrases are supported. Each phrase can be up to 20 characters in length. The sum of probabilities must be 1.0
fields.help_zh: 附和短语集合。最大 10 条，每条短语长度 ≤ 20 字符，概率总和为1.0
fields.name: words

fields.help_en: The backchanneling feature configuration module. After this feature is enabled, the system randomly broadcasts short backchanneling phrases at specific trigger stages
fields.help_zh: 附和语功能配置模块。开启后，系统会在特定触发时机随机播报简短的附和语
fields.name: back_channeling_configs

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable intelligent segmentation. After intelligent segmentation is enabled, segmented speech from the user is intelligently merged into a single sentence. Default value: true
fields.help_zh: 智能断句开关，开启智能断句后，用户说话的发生断句会智能合并成一句。默认为 true
fields.name: enable_intelligent_segment

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the push-to-talk mode. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 是否开启对讲机模式。默认值：false
fields.name: enable_push_to_talk

fields.help_en: The experimental feature parameters. Contact technical support if you have any requirements
fields.help_zh: 实验功能参数，有需求请联系答疑
fields.name: experimental_config

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable graceful shutdown. Default value: false.
Graceful shutdown: When the agent is stopped, it finishes broadcasting the current speech before shutting down. The maximum broadcast duration is 10 seconds
fields.help_zh:
是否优雅下线。默认 false。

优雅下线：当智能体被停止的时候，播报完当前说的话再停止，最多播报 10 秒
fields.name: graceful_shutdown

fields.help_en: The greeting. Modifications take effect the next time the user joins the call. Default value: none
fields.help_zh: 问候语，修改后下次入会生效。默认无
fields.name: greeting

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to support speech interruption. Default value: true
fields.help_zh: 是否支持语音打断，默认 true
fields.name: enable_voice_interrupt

fields.help_en: The list of specific words or phrases that trigger conversation interruption
fields.help_zh: 触发对话中断的特定词汇或短语列表
fields.name: interrupt_words

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain interrupt words when sending messages to the LLM. By default, interrupt words are discarded.
For example, if the interrupt word is "wait", the message "wait how is the weather today" is changed to "how is the weather today" after the interrupt word is discarded
fields.help_zh:
是否保留打断词送 LLM，默认丢弃。

举例：打断词是“稍等”。"稍等今天天气怎么样"丢弃打断词送 LLM后，变为"今天天气怎么样"
fields.name: keep_interrupt_words_for_llm

fields.help_en:
The ASR processing policy in No Interrupting mode. Valid values:
cache: Caches the ASR text. After the current turn ends, the cached ASR text is processed together in the next turn.
discard: Directly discards the ASR text.
Default value: cache
fields.help_zh:
<No Interrupting> 模式下的 ASR 处理策略

cache: 缓存ASR文本，当前轮次结束后，被缓存的asr文本会在下一个轮次一起被处理。

discard: 直接丢弃ASR文本。

默认处理是缓存ASR文本
fields.name: no_interrupt_mode

fields.help_en: The speech interruption policy configuration
fields.help_zh: 语音打断策略配置
fields.name: interrupt_config

fields.help_en: The parameters for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio. The value must be a JSON string. For more information about the parameter format, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2858132.html
fields.help_zh:
阿里云百炼应用中心参数，类型为JSON字符串。参数格式参考：
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2858132.html
fields.name: bailian_app_params

fields.help_en: The name of the built-in feature provided by the Alibaba Cloud agent system. Currently, only hangup is supported
fields.help_zh: 阿里智能体系统提供的内置功能名称。当前只支持hangup(挂断)
fields.name: function

fields.help_en: The name of the LLM function that corresponds to the feature. This name is customized by the user and is used to call the corresponding feature in the LLM. For more information about the user-defined LLM protocol, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839094.html
fields.help_zh: 要与该功能对应的LLM函数名称，由客户自定义，用于在LLM中调用对应功能。用户自定义llm协议参考：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839094.html
fields.name: match_function

fields.help_en: The function mapping list, which is used to map agent capabilities to LLM functions. Currently, only function calling with user-defined LLMs that use the OpenAI protocol is supported
fields.help_zh: 功能映射列表，用于将智能体能力与LLM函数对应。当前只支持和用户自定义openai协议llm的函数调用
fields.name: function_map

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to keep the LLM message history consistent with the text-to-speech (TTS) playback content. Default value: false. After this feature is enabled, the saved LLM messages are kept consistent with the TTS playback content.
When the user interrupts the agent in the LLM message history, the `<ims_agent_interrupted>` tag is inserted at the interruption position in the next message sent to the LLM. Example:
```
[
  {"role": "user", "content": "Tell me a story."},
  {"role": "assistant", "content": "Okay, let me tell you a story about Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Do<ims_agent_interrupted> you want to listen?"},
  {"role": "user", "content": "Tell me another one."}
]
```
fields.help_zh:
大模型消息历史，是否和tts播放内容保持一致。默认false。开启后，保存的大模型消息和tts播放内容保持一致。

大模型消息历史中当用户打断Agent时，下次发送给大模型的 message 会在打断位置插入 <ims_agent_interrupted> 标签。比如：

```
[
  {"role": "user", "content": "给我讲一个故事。"},
  {"role": "assistant", "content": "好的，我给你讲一个三国演义的故事吧，你<ims_agent_interrupted>想听吗？"},
  {"role": "user", "content": "换一个吧。"}
]
```
fields.name: history_sync_with_tts

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to send the complete LLM result to the client after the LLM generates the complete response. This switch does not affect the streaming generation of subtitles
fields.help_zh: 开启后，llm回复完整结果之后，智能体会向客户端发送完整llm结果。此开关不影响字幕的流式生成
fields.name: llm_complete_reply

fields.help_en: The actual text of the conversation content, which records the specific expression or response of the role in the conversation
fields.help_zh: 存储实际的对话内容文本，记录了该角色在对话中的具体表达或回应
fields.name: content

fields.help_en:
The role of the conversation participant. Valid values:
user: User.
assistant: Assistant.
system: System.
function: Function.
plugin: Plugin.
tool: Tool
fields.help_zh:
表示对话参与者的角色。可选值包括：

user: 用户

assistant: 助手



system: 系统


function: 函数



plugin: 插件



tool: 工具
fields.name: role

fields.help_en: The historical conversation context of the LLM or multimodal LLM
fields.help_zh: llm/mllm历史对话上下文
fields.name: llm_history

fields.help_en: The maximum number of retained turns for the historical conversation context of the LLM or multimodal LLM. Default value: 10
fields.help_zh: llm/mllm 历史对话上下文最大保留轮次，默认 10 次
fields.name: llm_history_limit

fields.example: You are the 1 friendly and helpful assistant, focused on providing accurate information and advice to users.
fields.help_en: The system prompt for the LLM after the call is started
fields.help_zh: 启动通话后 llm 的系统提示词
fields.name: llm_system_prompt

fields.help_en: The extra query parameters for the OpenAI-compatible LLM. Parameters must be in the key=value format. Multiple parameters are connected by an ampersand (&). All values must be of the string type
fields.help_zh: 额外的 OpenAI协议LLM的查询参数, 参数必须使用 key=value 格式,多个参数用 & 连接,所有值必须为字符串类型
fields.name: open_ai_extra_query

fields.help_en: The maximum delay time for text output in milliseconds. If this time is exceeded, the cached text is forcibly output. Valid values: 1000 to 10000. A value of 0 or empty indicates no limit. Default value: empty
fields.help_zh: 文本输出最大延迟时间（毫秒），超过该时间强制输出已缓存文本，。范围[1000,10000]，0或空表示不限制，默认空
fields.name: output_max_delay

fields.help_en: The minimum length of text output in characters. Text shorter than this length is cached and concatenated. Valid values: 0 to 100. A value of 0 or empty indicates no limit. Default value: empty
fields.help_zh: 文本输出最小长度（字符数），小于该长度的文本会被缓存等待拼接，范围[0, 100]，0或空表示不限制，默认空
fields.name: output_min_length

fields.help_en: The large language model (LLM) configuration
fields.help_zh: 大语言模型配置
fields.name: llm_config

fields.help_en: The maximum wait time without interaction with the agent. If this time is exceeded, the agent goes offline. Unit: seconds. Default value: 600
fields.help_zh: 和智能体无互动的最大等待时间，超时智能体下线。单位：秒。默认：600 秒
fields.name: max_idle_time

fields.help_en: The default transfer number. This is a backup number. You must still explicitly pass the called number when you initiate a transfer call
fields.help_zh: 默认转接号（备用，当前调用转呼时仍需显式传被叫号）
fields.name: called_number

fields.help_en: The caller number used for transfer calls. Configuring this field enables the RTC transfer capability. If this field is not configured, the behavior remains unchanged
fields.help_zh: 转呼时使用的主叫号。配置该字段即视为开启 RTC 转呼能力，不配置则行为与改动前完全一致
fields.name: caller_number

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform real-time speech recognition for both parties (the RTC user and the transferred phone party) after the transfer is connected. When enabled, the recognition results are pushed to the client as subtitles through the RTC message channel and written to the call record. Valid values:
true: Enabled. This is the default value.
false: Disabled. Subtitles and call records are not generated during the transfer
fields.help_zh:
转接接通后，是否对通话双方（RTC 用户和被转接的电话那一方）做实时语音识别。开启时，识别结果会作为字幕通过 RTC 消息通道推给客户端，同时写入通话记录。取值：
true（默认）：开启。
false：关闭，转接期间不再产生字幕和通话记录

The eagerness level. This parameter takes effect only in Semantic mode. It controls how quickly the AI starts to respond after detecting a pause:
Low: Patient waiting. The maximum wait time is 6 seconds, which reduces the risk of being interrupted.
Medium: Balanced waiting. The maximum wait time is 4 seconds, which is suitable for most scenarios.
High: Fast response. The maximum wait time is 2 seconds, which improves speed but may increase the risk of false cut-offs.
Default value: empty

"Medium"：平衡等待（最长等待时间4秒），适用大多数场景。
"High"：快速响应（最长等待时间2秒），提升速度但可能增加误切风险。

字段默认空

parameters.help_en:
The agent template configuration. [Deprecated] Use the AgentConfig parameter instead.

The agent configuration to be updated. This configuration is merged with the configuration used when the instance was started. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846193.html definition.
The following parameters in AIAgentTemplateConfig can be updated:

VoiceId (voice ID)

EnableVoiceInterrupt (enable voice interruption)

Greeting (greeting)

Volume (volume)

EnablePushToTalk (enable push-to-talk)

UseVoiceprint (use voiceprint)

AsrMaxSilence (maximum ASR silence duration)
parameters.help_zh:
智能体模版配置。已废弃，请使用AgentConfig字段。

需要更新的智能体配置，和实例启动所使用的配置进行合并更新。详见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2846193.html定义。
支持更新AIAgentTemplateConfig中的以下参数：

VoiceId（语音ID）

EnableVoiceInterrupt（启用语音打断）

Greeting（问候语）

Volume（音量）

EnablePushToTalk（启用按键通话）

UseVoiceprint（使用声纹）

AsrMaxSilence（ASR最大静音时间）
